findings_qualitative.value: N2H+ shows a cavity coincident with the H2CO outflow; CH3CN is enhanced around MC with anti-correlation to N2H+

evidence.quote: This spatial anti-correlation between N$_2$H$^+$ and CH$_3$CN emissions closely follows the MM2(E) outflow path.

claims.hypothesis: The outflow collides with the MC cloudlet
claims.experiment: H2CO PV diagrams and CH3CN LTE fits along the outflow
claims.result: X-shape, wider spray downstream, higher Tex, column density, line width and velocity near MC
claims.finding: Outflow is colliding with and ablating MC

evidence.quote: The X-shape feature detected to the north of the H$_2$CO molecular outflow suggests that this outflow could be colliding with the MC cloudlet.

claims.hypothesis: The outflow can erode its parent cloud and sustain turbulence
claims.experiment: Compare outflow energy and momentum with cloud turbulent and binding energy
claims.result: eta_out 0.55–2.64; momentum rate 7–9 times dissipation rate
claims.finding: Outflow is powerful enough to erode the cloud

evidence.quote: These relatively high values of $\eta_{out}$ indicate that MM2(E)’s outflow is very powerful

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Outflow escaping the cloud rear as alternative to collision; multiple streamlines vs episodic ejections not confirmed

evidence.quote: we cannot confirm this scenario

limitations_admitted.value: Momentum and energy not corrected for unknown inclination

evidence.quote: note that we give the momentum and energy without correcting by the unknown outflow inclination with respect to the line of sight

referee_caveats_inferred: Abundances of H2CO and N2H+ are uncertain by large factors, dominating mass and energy estimates
Tex range from CH3CN applied to H2CO
Collision vs escape-from-cloud interpretation not decisively separated
